\begin{lemma}[Monotonicity of work-tape windows]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.inWin_mono}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.inWin_mono}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.Cfg, Turing.Cfg.InWindow}
\difficulty{3}
Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let
$x$ be a binary input, and let $C$ be a configuration on $x$. If all work-tape heads of
$C$ lie in $[-s,s]$ and its work tapes are blank outside that interval, then for every
natural number $s'\ge s$, all its work-tape heads lie in $[-s',s']$ and its work tapes
are blank outside that larger interval.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[One-step window growth]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.inWin_stepWith}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.inWin_stepWith}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.ExpBFS.inWin_mono, Turing.Action.apply, Turing.Cfg, Turing.Cfg.InWindow, Turing.Cfg.inputSymbol, Turing.Cfg.workTapeSymbols, Turing.NDTM.stepWith, Turing.workTapePos_apply_le}
\difficulty{5}
Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet,
let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $C$ be a configuration of $N$ on $x$. If every
work-tape head of $C$ lies within distance $s$ of the origin and every work-tape cell
outside that range is blank, then after one step using either choice bit, every head
lies within distance $s+1$ and every cell outside that range is blank.
\end{lemma}

\begin{definition}[Winning computation prefix]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.Cfg.InWindow, Turing.FinNDTM, Turing.NDTM.initCfg, Turing.NDTM.runWith}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $x$ be a finite binary input,
let $s\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $w$ be a finite binary string. The string $w$ is a winning
computation prefix within window radius $s$ if, for every integer $j$ with $0\le j\le
|w|$, the configuration reached from the initial configuration on input $x$ after
reading the first $j$ choice bits of $w$ lies in the window of radius $s$.
\end{definition}

\begin{lemma}[Initial configuration lies in every window]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.inWin_init}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.inWin_init}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.Cfg.InWindow, Turing.Cfg.inWindow_init, Turing.NDTM.initCfg}
\difficulty{1}
Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let
$x$ be a binary input, and let $s$ be any natural number. The initial configuration of
$N$ on $x$ has every work-tape head in $[-s,s]$ and has blank contents at all work-tape
cells outside that interval.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Appending a Choice Bit to a Window-Bounded Run]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun.snoc}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun.snoc}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun, Turing.Cfg.InWindow, Turing.NDTM.initCfg, Turing.NDTM.runWith}
\difficulty{4}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$
and $w$ be binary strings, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $b$ be a bit. If every
configuration reached along every prefix of $w$ lies in the window of radius $s$, and
the configuration reached after the choice string $wb$ also lies in that window, then
every configuration reached along every prefix of $wb$ lies in the window of radius $s$.
\end{lemma}

\leanok

\difficulty{1}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$
and $w$ be binary strings, and let $s\le s'$ be natural numbers. If every configuration
reached from the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$ by following any prefix of $w$ lies
in the window of radius $s$, then every such configuration lies in the window of radius
$s'$ as well.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Final Configuration of a Window-Bounded Run]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun.last}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun.last}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun, Turing.Cfg.InWindow, Turing.NDTM.initCfg, Turing.NDTM.runWith}
\difficulty{1}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$
and $w$ be binary strings, and let $s$ be a natural number. If every configuration
reached from the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$ by following any prefix of $w$ lies
in the window of radius $s$, then the configuration reached by following all of $w$ also
lies in that window; that is, every work-tape head is at a position $z$ with $|z|\le s$,
and every work-tape cell at a position $z$ with $|z|>s$ is blank.
\end{lemma}

\begin{definition}[Reachable configuration code]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.StepRel, Complexity.Codec.cfgCode, Turing.FinNDTM, Turing.NDTM.initCfg}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $x$ be a finite binary input,
and let $s,u\in\mathbb{N}$. The code $u$ is reachable at radius $s$ if it can be
obtained from the code of the initial configuration of $N$ on input $x$ by zero or more
steps of the one-step relation on configuration codes at radius $s$.
\end{definition}

\begin{lemma}[Core data determined by configuration codes]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.coreSum_eq_of_code_eq}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.coreSum_eq_of_code_eq}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.bits_cfgCode, Complexity.Codec.cfgCode, Complexity.Codec.coreSum_eq_of_cfgWord_eq, Turing.Cfg, Turing.Cfg.InWindow, Turing.NDTM.coreSum}

Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let
$x$ be a binary input, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $C,D$ be configurations of
$N$ on $x$. Suppose both configurations have all work-tape heads in the interval
$[-s,s]$ and have blank contents at every work-tape cell outside that interval. If their
configuration codes for window size $s$ are equal, then their core data agree, including

and their output summaries agree.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Bound on reachable codes]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_lt}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_lt}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.cfgCode_lt, Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode, Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_iff, Complexity.logSpace}
\difficulty{1}
Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet,
let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $s,u$ be natural numbers. If $u$ is reachable from
the initial configuration code by zero or more encoded steps within the $s$-window, then
$u<2^{K(N)(s+\ell(|x|)+1)}$, where $K(N)$ is the fixed code-length parameter of $N$ and
$\ell(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{definition}[Bounded Configuration Codes]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.rset}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.rset}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode, Complexity.logSpace, Turing.FinNDTM}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$
be a finite binary input, and let $s$ be a natural number. The finite set $R(N,x,s)$
consists of the natural numbers $u$ satisfying $u<2^{K(N)(s+L(|x|)+1)}$ and the
predicate $RCode(N,x,s,u)$, where $K$ is the machine code-width function, $L$ is the
space-bound function, and $RCode$ is the defining predicate for these codes.
\end{definition}

\begin{lemma}[Reachability set membership]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.mem_rset}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.mem_rset}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode, Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_lt, Complexity.ExpBFS.rset}
\difficulty{3}
Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet,
let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $s,u$ be natural numbers. The number $u$ belongs to
the set of numbers below $2^{K(N)(s+\ell(|x|)+1)}$ that are reachable from the initial
configuration code by zero or more encoded $s$-window steps if and only if it is
reachable from that code by zero or more such steps; here $K(N)$ is the fixed
code-length parameter of $N$ and $\ell(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Cardinality of the Bounded Reachability Set]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.card_filter_rcode}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.card_filter_rcode}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode, Complexity.ExpBFS.mem_rset, Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_lt, Complexity.ExpBFS.rset, Complexity.logSpace}
\difficulty{4}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ be
a binary string, and let $s,K$ be natural numbers. If $2^{\kappa(N)(s+\ell(x)+1)}\le K$,
where $\kappa(N)$ is the configuration-code width parameter and $\ell(x)=\lfloor\log_2
|x|\rfloor+1$, then the number of integers $u<K$ reachable from the encoded initial
configuration by a finite chain of encoded one-step transitions that stay within the
radius-$s$ window equals the number of such integers $u<2^{\kappa(N)(s+\ell(x)+1)}$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{definition}[Re-encoded reachable configuration]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.recode}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.recode}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.cfgCode, Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode, Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_iff, Turing.FinNDTM, Turing.NDTM.initCfg, Turing.NDTM.runWith}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine, let $x$ be a finite binary input,
and let $s,u\in\mathbb{N}$. If $u$ is reachable at radius $s$, choose a sequence of
choice bits witnessing that reachability and let the value be the configuration code, at
radius $s+1$, of the configuration reached by running $N$ on $x$ with that sequence. If
$u$ is not reachable at radius $s$, let the value be zero.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Monotonicity of reachable-code counts]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.card_rset_le_succ}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.card_rset_le_succ}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.ExpBFS.recode_injOn, Complexity.ExpBFS.recode_mem, Complexity.ExpBFS.rset}
\difficulty{1}
Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let
$x$ be a binary input, and let $s$ be a natural number. For each $t$, let $R_t$ be the
set of codes of configurations reachable from the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$
by zero or more steps that stay within work-tape window $t$. These codes lie below
$2^{K(N)(t+\operatorname{logSpace}(|x|)+1)}$, where $K(N)$ is the code-length parameter
of $N$. Then $|R_s|\le |R_{s+1}|$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}[Image of reachable codes under recoding]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.image_recode_of_card_eq}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.image_recode_of_card_eq}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.ExpBFS.recode, Complexity.ExpBFS.recode_injOn, Complexity.ExpBFS.recode_mem, Complexity.ExpBFS.rset}
\difficulty{3}
Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let
$x$ be a binary input, and let $s$ be a natural number. For a code reachable from the
initial configuration using transitions within window $s$, recode it as the
configuration code at window size $s+1$ of a run witnessing that reachability; assign
$0$ to codes that are not reachable. If the sets of reachable codes in windows $s$ and
$s+1$ have equal cardinality, then the image of the window-$s$ reachable-code set under
this recoding is exactly the window-$(s+1)$ reachable-code set.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Acceptance from equal reachability counts]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.mem_iff_of_card_eq}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.mem_iff_of_card_eq}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.acceptLang, Complexity.Codec.mem_acceptLang, Complexity.Codec.mem_initLang, Complexity.Codec.mem_of_codePath, Complexity.ExpBFS.RCode, Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun.last, Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_iff, Complexity.ExpBFS.rset, Complexity.ExpBFS.winRun_of_card_eq, Turing.FinNDTM.DecidesInSpace, Turing.pairEncode}
\difficulty{4}
Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet,
let $L$ be a language of Boolean strings, and let $sp$ assign a natural-number space
bound to each input length. Suppose that for every input $y$ there is a time $T$ such
that every choice string of length $T$ makes $N$ halt, every such run uses at most
$sp(|y|)$ work-tape cells, and $y\in L$ exactly when some such run halts with output
$[\mathrm{true}]$. Fix an input $x$ and a window size $s$, and suppose the sets of codes
reachable from the initial configuration by zero or more steps within the $s$-window and
within the $(s+1)$-window have equal cardinality. Then $x\in L$ if and only if there is
a number $u$ reachable by zero or more encoded $s$-window steps from the initial
configuration code such that the code $u$, paired with $x$ and $s$, encodes a halted
configuration with output $[\mathrm{true}]$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{lemma}[Runs remain within the deciding space bound]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.inWin_runWith_of_decides}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.inWin_runWith_of_decides}
\leanok
\uses{Turing.Cfg.InWindow, Turing.FinNDTM.DecidesInSpace, Turing.NDTM.initCfg, Turing.NDTM.runWith, Turing.NDTM.runWith_append, Turing.NDTM.runWith_of_halt, Turing.NDTM.runWith_take_inWindow}
\difficulty{5}
Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let
$L$ be a language of binary strings, and let $sp:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Suppose $N$
decides $L$ within space bound $sp$, meaning that on every input there is a time bound
by which every branch halts, every branch of that length uses at most the prescribed
space, and acceptance agrees with membership in $L$. Then for every binary input $x$ and
every finite choice word $w$, the configuration reached from the initial configuration
on $x$ by running with $w$ has all work-tape heads in $[-sp(|x|),sp(|x|)]$ and blank
work-tape cells outside that interval.
\end{lemma}

\begin{theorem}[Stability of reachable-code counts]
\lean{Complexity.ExpBFS.card_rset_succ_of_le}
\label{Complexity.ExpBFS.card_rset_succ_of_le}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.ExpBFS.WinRun, Complexity.ExpBFS.card_rset_le_succ, Complexity.ExpBFS.inWin_mono, Complexity.ExpBFS.inWin_runWith_of_decides, Complexity.ExpBFS.mem_rset, Complexity.ExpBFS.rcode_iff, Complexity.ExpBFS.recode, Complexity.ExpBFS.recode_spec, Complexity.ExpBFS.rset, Turing.FinNDTM.DecidesInSpace}

$L$ be a language of binary strings, let $sp:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$, and let $x$ be a
